diagnosis.root_cause: The DDS fast pixel-mask decoder selected D3DFMT_A8R8G8B8 or A8B8G8R8 when only the high-byte mask matched, without requiring DDPF_ALPHAPIXELS. An RGB-only opaque sprite retaining a stale FF high-byte mask could thus read undefined/zero high bytes as alpha.
alternatives_rejected: Texture placement/aspect and prior X8 mask-zero decoding already exist, so neither lens/GOAL hooks nor R84 compositor changes address this source format mismatch.
diagnosis.runtime_limit: Classification bug established from source; actual affected DDS from user's car-selection pack not yet collected, no HMD/Quest3 visual test.
